cooling_off.notes: This is the ONLY Bain-owned page found stating a numeric reapplication period. It sits on a LEGACY path (/careers-old/) for Southeast Asia recruiting, not on the current global careers site. The sentence itself does not name the trigger (rejection vs. any prior application), does not name the roles covered, and does not mention assessment retakes; 'in line with our global approach to recruiting' is Bain's own wording and is the basis for scope=all_roles. The current ACI program page and ACI hiring-process page say NOTHING about reapplication.
